items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1996-08-23
items.q: And then of course, like we didn't cover, in 1942, when Andy Kirk came here. He came with Big June Richmond, who weighed about 300 pounds at the time, because she's living in Europe right now. And she was a tremendous vocalist.

ctx.x: Oh, I'm fine. It'll pick up. It always picks up. Okay, we'll continue with Tech Stevens. This is the, let's make sure this one's working. Okay, continuing with Tech Stevens. Today is August the 23rd. I think it's 23rd, Saturday 23rd. We're at Tulane University. My name's Tad Jones, and we're with Techs. So we were going to pick up, go back and listen to, you know, talk about some other, some things that we left off.

We left off. Yeah, well let's fill in where we left off. Let's go back to the 40s and we'll update things. Some of the things we didn't cover, like when Oyskin Hawkins came here in 1949. He played at the Booker T. Washington Auditorium. And incidentally, Mabel Scott played at Foster's Rainbow Room, and Gate Mouth Brown played together. And then they went over to the Dewdrop, and they did a midnight show like that was back there in 1949. And I think I discussed with you earlier about Amos Milburn and Winoni Harris…
